post.description:
Project API Key -> a short-lived runtime identity for one agent session.

Connectors call this once at start-up. The developer never mints a token;
agent-plane resolves the project, registers the integration, and hands back
the identifiers the connector should attach to everything it reports.

delete.description:
Revoke a lease outright, effective immediately. Kept in the store, not
deleted, so `GET /v1/leases/{id}` still shows it for audit.

Response Get Lease V1 Leases  Lease Id  Get

patch.description:
Narrow an active lease's authority in place. Only a subset of the
lease's current resources/actions/max_uses/maximum_impact/expiry - same
"never grants more" rule as delegation; widening is refused.

schema.title: Response Shrink Lease V1 Leases  Lease Id  Patch

post.description:
The lease holder mints an attenuated child lease (self-service, like
`POST /v1/agents/delegate` - not admin-gated). Child scope must be a
subset of the parent's; the parent must allow delegation at all
(`child_authority != "none"`).

get.description: This project's permissions as YAML, ready to commit next to the code.

schema.title: Response Export Rules V1 Rules Export Get

post.description:
Apply a permissions file.

``merge`` (the default) creates what is new and updates what a rule of the
same name already says, leaving anything the file does not mention alone.
``replace`` makes the file the whole truth for this project and deletes the
rest, which is what config-as-code usually wants and is never the default
because it throws away rules someone wrote in the console.
